authority: Planning V1 remains the sole production and Draft authority
mode: consume the exact same authority snapshot
run offline fixtures/fakes first; separately approved shadow Provider use is optional later
persist V2 artifacts under isolated shadow root/ledger
never feed V2 outputs to Draft, Canon, StoryState, READY, causal/manifest production files or Maintenance
failures cannot alter V1 recovery or outcome
promotion_phases: Phase A: deterministic historical replay and fake model fixtures
Phase B: V1-produced accepted inputs replayed through V2 assembly/closure without model calls
Phase C: separately approved shadow generation with isolated outputs
Phase D: decision review; any production cutover requires a new implementation and Canary approval
rollback: Delete/ignore isolated shadow outputs or disable shadow invocation; V1 bytes and checkpoints remain unchanged.
live_parity: Not run in this design task. Future shadow validation compares source/config/runtime fingerprints before any external action.
